brief:
France approved dozens of new military equipment sales to Israel even as President Macron denounced Gaza as "a spectacle that shames us all," Middle East Eye reported. The finding emerged from research into French arms transfers at a time when the French leader has been among Western voices criticizing the conduct of Israel's military operations.

The report highlights a disconnect between France's public statements on the Gaza conflict and its continued authorization of weapons sales to the Israeli military.

title: France approves new military equipment sales to Israel
